title: Output Schema for Browse Operation
description: Output schema for the Solace browse operation.

payload.description: The list of browsed message summaries. The queue is left undisturbed — messages are not consumed.

items.description: A summary of a single browsed message.

destination.description: The name of the destination the message was published to.

payload.description: The message body as a UTF-8 string. Inspect contentType to determine how to interpret it.

contentType.description: The content type of the message payload (e.g., application/json, application/xml, text/plain).

correlationId.description: The correlation id of the message.

senderId.description: The sender id of the message.

deliveryMode.description: The delivery mode of the message (e.g., DIRECT, PERSISTENT, NON_PERSISTENT).

redelivered.description: Whether the message was flagged as redelivered by the broker.

dmqEligible.description: Whether the message is eligible for the Dead Message Queue.

elidingEligible.description: Whether the message is eligible for eliding.

expiration.description: Absolute message expiration time as a UTC epoch in milliseconds. Present only when non-zero.

timeToLive.description: Time to live in milliseconds. Present only when non-zero.

senderTimestamp.description: Sender-supplied timestamp as a UTC epoch in milliseconds. Present only when set.

receiveTimestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the message was received. Present only when non-zero.

sequenceNumber.description: The publisher-assigned sequence number. Present only when set.

replyTo.description: The reply-to destination of the message, when present.

type.description: The reply-to destination type (TOPIC or QUEUE).

userProperties.description: Publisher-supplied user properties carried on the message.

destination.description: The name of the queue that was browsed.

messageCount.description: The number of messages returned by the browse.

headers.description: Transport headers associated with the response.
